open.title: Issues with Durable Objects and Dependent Services
open.text: We are investigating reports of elevated timeout rates and performance degradation affecting Durable Objects. This may impact dependent services, including Stream and Containers. Our team is actively investigating, and further updates will be provided shortly.

open.title: Errors and stalled predictions on some models
open.text:
The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.

Current impact: predictions on OpenAI models are back to normal. Predictions on other models may still return HTTP 500 errors or stay in a processing state while we continue to work on a fix.

open.title: Changes to Cloudflare Workers are not producing Event Subscription events
open.text: The issue has been identified and a fix is being implemented.

open.title: Edge Delivery Issues in Singapore and Japan Regions
open.text: We have confirmed that Edge Delivery in the Singapore and Japan regions resumed healthy service at approximately 18:15 UTC on November 17, 2026. We are continuing to investigate this issue in an effort to prevent this issue from reoccurring during the next regional peak traffic window. Customers and partners can find more details on the Akamai Community: https://community.akamai.com/customers/s/fe

open.title: Costs API data is delayed
open.text: We've pushed a fix and are monitoring the recovery.

open.title: Claude unable to join meetings
open.text: Claude Meetings (beta) is joining calls more reliably, and we are monitoring it. It remains enabled for all Enterprise customers. Team customers can again add Claude to new calls manually, and Auto-join is being restored gradually for Team customers.

open.title: Programmable Messaging API Errors
open.text: We are monitoring an issue that occurred between 15:20 PST and 15:21 PST with the Programmable Messaging API due to a third-party provider. Users may have experienced elevated HTTP 5xx status codes when sending outbound messages. We will provide another update in 1 hour or as soon as more information becomes available.

open.title: Voice Call Audio Quality Degradation and Silent and One-Way Audio between Twilio and Multiple Networks in Brazil
open.text: Twilio customers may be experiencing voice call audio quality degradation and silent and one-way audio between Twilio and network subscribers on multiple networks in Brazil. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 1 hour, 43 minutes or as soon as more information becomes available.

open.title: Voice Call Audio Quality Degradation Between Twilio and Multiple Networks in United Kingdom
open.text: Twilio customers may be experiencing voice call audio quality degradation between Twilio and network subscribers on multiple networks in the United Kingdom. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 8 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

open.title: Voice Call Failures from a Subset of Twilio Philippines Phone Numbers to Multiple Networks in Philippines
open.text: Twilio customers may be experiencing voice call failures from a subset of Twilio Philippines Phone Numbers to network subscribers on multiple networks in the Philippines. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. We will provide another update in 24 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

open.title: SMS Delivery Receipt Delays from a Subset of Twilio Long Codes to Multiple Networks in Chile
open.text: Twilio customers may be experiencing SMS delivery receipt delays from a subset of Twilio Long Codes to network subscribers on multiple networks in Chile. Our team has identified the cause, and is working to resolve the issue. Message delivery may succeed, but delivery receipts may be delayed. We will provide another update in 24 hours or as soon as more information becomes available.

open.title: Memecore (M) Deposits Disabled
open.text: Withdrawals for Memecore (M) are available again. As a precautionary measure, deposits have been disabled. Further updates will be communicated separately.

open.title: Stablr USD (USDR) and Stablr Euro (EURR) Funding Methods Halted
open.text: We are continuing to work on a fix for this issue.

open.title: ACH Deposits Cancelled
open.text: A fix has been implemented for the issue affecting ACH deposits, and ACH deposits can now be initiated again. Deposits that were cancelled did not move any funds, and customers can resubmit them. We are monitoring to confirm that deposits continue to complete successfully.
